adopted_facts: NVIDIA said GTC 2026 would run March 16-19 in San Jose, with 1,000+ sessions and a five-layer AI stack spanning energy, chips, infrastructure, models and applications.

NVIDIA announced Vera Rubin as a rack-scale AI factory platform including Vera CPU, Rubin GPU, NVLink 6, ConnectX-9, BlueField-4 DPU and Spectrum-6 Ethernet switch for pretraining, post-training and agentic inference.

NVIDIA launched Vera CPU, claiming 2x efficiency and 50% faster results than traditional rack-scale CPUs; partners include cloud providers and system manufacturers such as Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Supermicro and Taiwan ODMs.
At NVIDIA GTC Taipei, NVIDIA said Vera Rubin is ramping into full production and highlighted Spectrum-X Ethernet Photonics with co-packaged optics for million-GPU AI factories.

NVIDIA launched Vera CPU, claiming 2x efficiency and 50% faster results than traditional rack-scale CPUs; partners include cloud providers and system manufacturers such as Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Supermicro and Taiwan ODMs.
Dell marked the two-year anniversary of Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA and introduced PowerEdge XE9812 leveraging NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 for enterprise and neocloud AI infrastructure.
NVIDIA said GTC 2026 would run March 16-19 in San Jose, with 1,000+ sessions and a five-layer AI stack spanning energy, chips, infrastructure, models and applications.

NVIDIA announced Vera Rubin as a rack-scale AI factory platform including Vera CPU, Rubin GPU, NVLink 6, ConnectX-9, BlueField-4 DPU and Spectrum-6 Ethernet switch for pretraining, post-training and agentic inference.
Vertiv said it is contributing DSX SimReady digital power and cooling assets, validated interfaces and repeatable infrastructure blocks for NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI factory reference designs.
NVIDIA announced RTX Spark for Windows PCs, with 1 petaflop of AI performance, up to 128GB unified memory and fall availability from OEMs including ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft Surface and MSI.
Microsoft said RTX Spark-powered Windows PCs would start with Surface, ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo and MSI, positioning local AI agents as a new PC use case.
NVIDIA announced physical AI partnerships across robotics, industrial automation and humanoids, with Cosmos, Isaac and GR00T model/framework updates.
NVIDIA said BYD, Geely, Isuzu, Nissan and mobility platforms are adopting DRIVE Hyperion for L4-ready vehicles, and highlighted robotaxi deployment plans with Uber.
